summary: REQUEST_CHANGES。基础 rematch 的 interval、确定性贪心、几何过滤、双向 fail-closed、holding 记账和 receipt plumbing 基本正确。但 queued learning-forward 包迁回 holding 后会以未结算 transition 重决策并触发 KernelError；旧拓扑 control snapshot 可跨 rematch drain 后按新 peer 的同名方向静默解释，污染 delay/capacity routing。另有动态 ISL 绕过 max_entities、retired draining state 不进入 global snapshot/Q0 live index。queued data 实际迁 holding，queued control 与 current service 才 drain；账目守恒但控制拓扑语义并非 fail-closed。

findings.summary: FACT: rematch 迁移尚未开始 ISL service 的 learning-forward 包时不结算/取消 open transition；下一次 pending 重决策对 forward+reward=None 明确抛 KernelError。

INFERENCE strongly supported by code: queued control intentionally drains retired links, but pre-rematch direction-keyed queue/propagation metrics carry no topology epoch/peer binding and are accepted after rematch; delay/capacity routing resolves that direction against the current peer, silently misbinding old-edge metrics to a new edge.
FACT: max_entities is checked only for initial ISLs; every rematch may retain old ISLLink objects and allocate replacements without rechecking the configured entity cap.

FACT: retired ISLs participate in drain/final accounting but snapshot_global and Q0 live-packet indexing traverse only current self.isls, hiding retired control queues and retired-link current data/control service.

FACT: core rematch mechanics otherwise use deterministic range/a/b ordering, current geometry legality, bidirectional fail-closed construction, routing-structure rebuilds, finite FIFO holding accounting, and strict topo_recomputes receipt plumbing.

recommendedActions: 修复 rematch 数据迁移对 open forward learning transition 的生命周期：迁回 holding 前显式结算、取消或定义 rematch transition 语义，并加入尚未 service-start 的学习包回归测试。
给 control snapshot 的 topology-dependent ISL metrics 增加 topology epoch/peer binding；rematch 后对不匹配缓存 fail closed 或丢弃这些字段，禁止按新 peer 静默解释旧 direction metric。
为 retired ISL 建立明确生命周期和回收条件，并将动态创建对象纳入 max_entities 检查。
让 global snapshot/Q0 live-state 显式包含 retired/draining ISL，或定义单独 retired_links 区域，避免隐藏正在 drain 的控制和服务中数据。
